title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Given the `root` of a binary tree represented as an array in level-order, return the level order traversal of its nodes values. (i.e., from left to right, level by level). The array is in heap order: the children of the node at index `i` are at indexes `2i + 1` and `2i + 2`, and `null` means no node there.

hints.content: Use a Queue for Breadth-First Search (BFS).
At each level, record queue.length and process that many nodes.
For array representation, track level index: level 0 has [0], level 1 has [1, 2], etc.

solution.explanation:
BFS or DFS with level index. Group node values into subarrays by their depth.
Time Complexity: O(n)
Space Complexity: O(n)
